    About Me

    I am Jungho Lee, a Research Scientist at NAVER AI Lab. I received my Ph.D. in School of Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Yonsei University. Before joining NAVER AI Lab, I worked as a research intern at NAVER Cloud on 3D scene representation.

    My research lies in 3D computer vision and visual intelligence. I am interested in building robust and scalable systems that can perceive, reconstruct, and understand the 3D world from real-world visual observations.

    If you are interested in me, feel free to contact me.
